notes: Numeric export from actual local model runs. No source audio, reference text, hypotheses, translations or private paths included.
Native provenance collected separately for older raw reports that did not embed it. Core ML settings apply only to runs labelled cpp-coreml.

No browser capture, network livestream timing, power, memory peak, or ANE utilization was measured.
